title: MissionSpec
description: Declarative unit of team work: one goal, one paradigm, one exit contract. Mission kinds are catalog labels, never engine enums.

kind.description: Free-form catalog label (e.g. hypothesis_atelier, build_fix). Informational only; the engine must not branch on it.

paradigm.description: Coordination template id resolved from the paradigm/team registry.

roster.description: Optional roster override; when absent the paradigm template members are used.

exit_contract.description: Schema id or path of the artifact contract that must validate for the mission to complete.

inputs.description: KB references or literal inputs handed to the team (e.g. prior mission artifacts).

coordination_overrides.description: Tightening-only overrides applied on top of the paradigm template coordination.
